title: Bounded Representatives in Critical Sobolev-Hodge Spaces
summary: Let $n\geq 2$, $1\leq \ell\leq n-1$, and $1<p<\infty$. We prove that every $v\in \dot W^{n/p,p}(\mathbb{R}^n;Λ^\ell)$ has a representative $u\in \dot W^{n/p,p}\cap L^\infty$ with $du=dv$ and $\max{|u|{\dot W^{n/p,p}},|u|{L^\infty}}\lesssim |v|{\dot W^{n/p,p}}$. Equivalently, $d[\dot W^{n/p,p}Λ^\ell]=d[(\dot W^{n/p,p}\cap L^\infty)Λ^\ell]$ with equivalent quotient norms. The proof reduces the selection problem to an endpoint graph estimate for a Riesz potential and the exact Hodge projection.
